directly_supported: Under the frozen candidate, O03 contract, post-trace task, and baseline configurations, C0 training produced high false-positive rates on the small-positive Timing hard-negative role while ordinary-normal false positives remained near zero.

Replacing half of the ordinary-normal C0 training class with semantic hard negatives changed boundary false-positive behavior in every model family, with the largest and most consistent change on the Timing hard-negative role.

For Decision Tree and Random Forest, C1 strongly reduced Timing-hard-negative false positives and increased aggregate F1 and balanced accuracy without reducing median Timing-anomaly or Nonce-anomaly recall.
For Logistic Regression, C1 reduced Timing-hard-negative false positives only partially and showed a model-specific Timing-anomaly recall trade-off, while Nonce-anomaly recall remained unchanged.

Removing the three C1 predicate-equivalent relation features affected model families differently: Logistic Regression and Random Forest showed lower aggregate outcomes and Timing-anomaly recall, while Decision Tree median outcomes were largely retained.

In the single approved device-disjoint sensitivity split, the strong Decision Tree and Random Forest C0-to-C1 pattern persisted, whereas Logistic Regression retained a partial Timing-hard-negative reduction with lower aggregate outcomes and Timing-anomaly recall.
Nonce-anomaly recall was comparatively stable across the frozen primary and grouped evaluations.
supported_with_qualification: Semantic hard-negative training can change measured separability and error distribution, restricted to this controlled Timing/Nonce synthetic candidate and frozen evaluation protocol.

Explicitly reconstructed semantic-relation features materially support separability for some baseline families, particularly Logistic Regression and Random Forest, but this dependence is not universal across the three baselines.
The device-disjoint results provide secondary descriptive sensitivity evidence for one 48/16-device synthetic partition; they are not a powered generalization estimate.
The observed effects concern complete-trace offline classification under O03 and do not establish event-time or operational monitoring performance.
not_supported: A new or superior anomaly detector
A best classifier or model-family ranking
Generalization outside the Timing and Nonce families
